verifications.claim: European qualifying for the 2026 FIFA World Cup is complete.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The race to qualify for the 2026 FIFA World Cup is complete." (R3); "UEFA qualifying for the 2026 men’s World Cup is done" (R9); "the 2026 World Cup field of 48 teams will be set" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state that European qualifying is complete after the playoffs.

verifications.claim: 16 UEFA teams earned spots in the 48-team 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "expanding from 32 teams... to 48, with Europe sending 16 nations" (R2); lists 16 European teams (R5); "final four European teams that joined the twelve group winners" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 16 UEFA spots in the 48-team tournament, listing them explicitly.

verifications.claim: The 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament locations are USA, Mexico, Canada.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Canada, Mexico and the United States" (R7); "in Canada, Mexico and the United States" (R6); co-hosts listed (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently name USA, Mexico, Canada as the host locations.

verifications.claim: There are 16 European spots in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Europe sending 16 nations" (R2); "16 UEFA spots" (R9); 12 group winners + 4 playoff (R7)

verifications.claim: The playoff format for European qualifying was single-leg semi-finals on March 26, 2026 and finals on March 31, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Play-off semi-finals Thursday 26 March 2026... Play-off finals Tuesday 31 March 2026" (R1); "two single-leg semi-finals on 26 March, and one single-leg final on 31 March 2026" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact dates and single-leg format match sources.

verifications.claim: The 12 group runners-up and four UEFA Nations League teams competed in single-leg knockout paths in the March 2026 playoffs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The twelve runners-up from the first round... joined by four teams based on the 2024–25 UEFA Nations League" (R7); "Twelve group runners-up plus the four top remaining UEFA Nations League group winners" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Precise description of participants and format in sources.

verifications.claim: The 2026 World Cup qualified European teams group winners are Austria, Belgium, Croatia, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Scotland, Spain, Switzerland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Group standings show tops: A Germany, B Switzerland, C Scotland, D France, E Spain, F Portugal, G Netherlands, H Austria, I Norway, J Belgium, K England, L Croatia (R3); listed as group winners (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Exact list matches group winners from standings.

verifications.claim: The playoff winners are Bosnia and Herzegovina, Czechia, Sweden, Turkey.

verifications.evidence: "Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Czech Republic, Sweden and Turkey qualified" (R7); lists Bosnia, Czechia, Sweden, Turkey/Türkiye (multiple)

verifications.reasoning: Exact score and penalty result confirmed.
